name: Piero Dusio
features: olive skin, dark hair greying, dark eyes, broad prosperous face, solid build, genial businesslike expression
bio: A professional footballer turned textile magnate who raced Maseratis and Alfas as a gentleman driver through the 1930s. After the war he founded Cisitalia, funded the extraordinary Porsche-designed Type 360 Grand Prix car, and bankrupted himself doing it.
